# CommandLine <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CommandLine:String
```

**Returns:** The arguments the program was started with as one string, with a space between them. It is empty when there are none. A program run by `blitzcc` gets the arguments given after `--args`.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "Started with: " + CommandLine$()
```
